title: Deep Learning Analysis of Echocardiographic Images to Predict Positive Genotype in Patients With Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
summary: A deep CNN analyzed echocardiographic images from 99 hypertrophic-cardiomyopathy patients (45 genotype-positive, 54 negative) and added its probability to established clinical scores, with Grad-CAM localizing the image features used. The network's probability alone reached AUC 0.76; combined with the Mayo score it reached 0.86 versus 0.72 for Mayo alone, and with the Toronto score 0.84 versus 0.75. The cohort is small and there is no external validation.
